costs: Keep execution and improvement accounts separate; include failed trials, warmups and diagnostics in their tagged accounts
local_compute: GPU inference/perception/planning consume time and compute even if they produce no remote planner tokens
time: Use monotonic intervals on one host; do not add overlapping intervals or subtract unrelated host clocks
cold: Fresh processes only; filesystem/kernel/model caches are not deliberately cleared
continuous: Top-level process reuse; code workers may still reload at official reset
provider_cost: Token count is not currency cost; cache/reasoning/image subsets must not be double-counted

project_a.restriction: Do not divide A physical duration by B wall time; no equal-quality causal algorithm ratio

system2_limits: New rounds measure only their own improvement cost, not the original released skills training/development cost
